summary: Mobile frontend (Expo web preview) tested for two new features: (1) AnnouncementBanner overlay + (2) Mobile User Detail screen. All flows PASSED. Banner appears on all 4 tabs (Görevler/Takım/Bildirim/Profil); critical/require_ack=true hides X and only shows ANLADIM; info/require_ack=false shows both X and ANLADIM; X dismiss hides for session only (banner returns after reload); ANLADIM ACK calls POST /api/announcements/{id}/ack and banner does NOT return after reload (acked persists). User Detail screen loads profile+quota+summary correctly; emp1_test shows stats grid (19 Toplam / 1 Tamamlanan / 18 Bekleyen / 0 Duraklatılan / 13 Geciken) and quota Deneme (30 gün) 0,01 MB / 100 MB; serkan (self) correctly shows 'Bu kullanıcı için görev özeti görünmüyor.' Regression: DÜZENLE opens UserFormModal, SİL opens ConfirmModal, FAB admin-user-add still opens create modal with username + password fields.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow' instead. Occurs on all Expo web renders (likely from FAB shadowColor/shadowOpacity in /app/mobile/app/settings/users.tsx:154 and possibly other cards).
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Likely from a library or a View using the deprecated prop; low severity.

action_items: (Low-priority) Replace deprecated 'shadow*' StyleSheet props with 'boxShadow' for RN Web compatibility; and replace props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: AnnouncementBanner is an absolute overlay pinned at top with paddingTop = insets.top + xs but there is NO corresponding top padding pushed into the tab content. On tabs where the first content row starts at insets.top, the banner may visually cover the header/search row. Observed: on GÖREVLER the banner overlays the SERTEX title header (screenshot). If this is by design (2b was chosen), ignore; otherwise consider adding a spacer equal to banner height so content is not obscured.

AnnouncementBanner polls every 60s but only reads server-side acked list on refresh; if user acks on one device, the other in-memory list still contains it until the next poll. Acceptable for a 60s window.
seed_data_creation: Created two announcements via POST /api/announcements for banner testing: (a) info + require_ack=false (b) critical + require_ack=true. Both purged via DELETE /api/announcements/{id}/purge after testing. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cleanup successful: only the pre-existing (inactive) announcement 'ZZ Ann 5j7qt' remains. Note: single-session caveat — any curl login as serkan kicks the mobile serkan session (401 SESSION_KICKED) and vice versa; sequence your API prep and UI login accordingly.
